prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Rufflet (수리둥보) personified, normal / flying type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized clothing and accessory detail. Render the face and outfit at the same polished intensity.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her species shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never armor, never a creature costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

WORLD: this scene happens inside the Pokémon world, as if she simply lives there — its towns, routes, buildings, props, light and weather show the world. No Pokémon unless SCENE names her companion, no known trainers or characters, no logos, no text.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: a sunny room with a grooming mat, a towel and a small brush basket
Companion: her one Pokémon companion is with her in this scene, close beside her.
Outfit: A mint performance jumpsuit with a secure plunging neckline and high thigh slits in the wide trouser legs.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body facing the camera; head turned to the side; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her knee.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a Poké Ball at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: she looks toward the left of the frame.
EXPRESSION: drooping lids and brows, dull tired eyes, mouth slightly open and slack.
Scene note: Late-afternoon sunlight falls across the grooming mat, towel and little brush basket; a small Pichu rests on the mat.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: mostly posed — a paused or held moment of the selected activity
source_influence: strong — her species is clearly recognizable through a few accessories and props in the scene, never through the outfit's colours, patterns or cut; no new armor or creature anatomy
separates_preference: balanced — choose either a one-piece outfit or separates to suit the scene

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its armor, garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her source belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

ONE WOMAN ONLY, with exactly one Pokémon companion as the scene describes — a separate creature at its own natural scale, its body never merged with hers, not a second human and not dressed like her. No other person or creature, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.
